a: ध्यान — [ध्यै-भावे-ल्युट्] 1 Meditation, reflection, thought, contemplation; ज्ञानाद् ध्यानं विशिष्यते Bg. 12. 12; Ms. 1. 12, 6. 72. --2 Especially, abstract contemplation, religious meditation; तदैव ध्यानादवगतोऽस्मि Ś. 7; R. 1. 73. --3 Divine intuition or discernment. --4 Mental representation of the personal attributes of a deity; इति ध्यानं. --Comp. --गम्य a. attainable by meditation only. --तत्पर, --निष्ठ, --पर a. lost in thought, absorbed in meditation, contemplative. --मात्रं mere thought or reflection. --योगः profound meditation. --स्थ a. absorbed in meditation, lost in thought.
